availability.note: Live Build & Price line 'IM5 PREMIUM' with price; VIC in the state selector; three grades only, matching the mgmotor.com.au/im5 spec table. CarsGuide's 'Platinum + Air Suspension' ($71,980) is the configurator's $3,990 suspension upgrade option, not a grade

listPrice.note: No list price published; MG labels every IM5 figure 'Drive Away Price' and its T&Cs say the drive-away price 'includes 12 months registration and 12 months compulsory third-party insurance (CTP)' and 'maximum dealer delivery charge and estimated stamp duty'. Configurator (NSW Private shown) gives 60,990 struck through and 57,990* as an offer with a $3,000 cashback + $500 accessories on IM5 sold/delivered 01 Nov-31 Dec 2026 (campaign, not used). 60,990 is the regular price: unchanged since the 2026-07-31 research and matching the CarsGuide price page (which mislabels it MSRP, aggregator lead only); launch prices (CarExpert, Aug 2025) were $60,990/$69,990/$80,990. Treated as MG's flat national drive-away per the mg-s5/mg-4 finding. Back-out: (60990 - 958.80) / 1.042 = 57,612; round-trip driveAwayPrice(57687) = 60,989.85. Independent per-state check not possible this run (raw configurator fetch refused). Because the figure bundles maximum dealer delivery, this list likely overstates by an estimated $1,500-2,000. Re-derived 2026-11-27 for VIC rego $958.80 (was 57,687 at $880; round trip 60990.50).
